verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Ixik t'a spalacio winh sreyal Judá, tzalan juntzanh lolonel tik
t'a winh, haton winh yinhtilal winhaj David. Tzalan pax t'a yichanh masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet' winh yet' pax t'a heb' anima ay ta' to smaklej yab' in lolonel tik heb'.

Ha tojolal yet' wach'ilal a tze b'eyb'alej. Manh eyixtej heb' eyetanimail, manh eyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ma heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Manh he milcham heb' anima malaj smul.

Tato t'a wal yel ol he b'eyb'alej juntzanh swal tik, ol ochnhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj David reyal t'a tik. Ayoch heb' t'a yol carruaje yet' t'a yib'anh chej ol ochta heb' t'a spuertail palacio tik, ajun masanil heb' ay yopisio yet' heb' yet' pax heb' anima.
Palta tato manh ol he cha eyab' juntzanh ix wal a in Jehová in tik jun, a jun palacio tik ol satelok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik. Ha spalacio winh sreyal Judá, ha t'a yol in sat lajan wal icha swach'il yilji lum Galaad, icha pax lum jolom witz Líbano. Palta swak' in ti' swalani to ol meltzajkanoch icha tzinan luumal. Manhxa mach ol kajnaj t'ay.
Ol wik'kot heb' anima ay syamk'ab' yik owal t'a jun palacio tik yik satanel heb'. Ol smak'anelta te' k'ute' heb', haton te' manh jantakok swach'il ayoch spatzab'ilok, ol snhusankantz'a te' heb'.
Ol kot heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', ol ek' heb' t'a stz'ey jun chonhab' tik, ol laj sk'anb'an heb' t'ay junjun: ¿Tas yuj icha tik ix yutej jun niwan chonhab' tik Jehová? xcham heb'.

Ol tak'wok juntzanhxo heb' icha tik: Icha tik ix yutej Jehová sDiosal heb', yujto ix yaktejkan strato heb' sb'onak yet'ok, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'aj ix och heb' ejmelal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Manh ex ok' yuj schamel winhaj Josías, ok'anhek yuj winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Josías chi'. Yujto ix ik'jib'at winh t'a junelnhej, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol meltzaj winh, manhxo ol yil-laj schonhab' winh b'aj aljinak. Ha yuj winhaj Salum chi', winh ix och sreyalok Judá ayik toxo ix cham winh smam winh chi', a Jehová tz'alan yuj winh icha tik. Ix ik'jiel winh t'a jun chonhab' tik, manhxo ol meltzajlaj winh.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' b'aj ix ik'jib'at winh chi', hata' ol cham winh. Manhxo ol ul yilxi schonhab' winh tik.
Ob'iltak ach, yuj wal a chukal tza b'oank'e a palacio yet' a niwak pat. Tzak' munlaj heb' anima, palta max a tuplaj sk'u heb'.

Tzalan icha tik: Ol in b'ok'e junok in niwan palacio, haxo t'a yib'anh ol in b'ok'e juntzanhxo lewan tz'aj yool. Ol jakwokkan swentenail, haxo te' k'ute' ol wak'och yichtakok, haxo yelaw, chakchak ol ajok, xa chi.

¿Am a naani to yujnhejto ayachek' t'a yoltak pat nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'ay, yuj chi' rey ach to niwan elk'ochi? Ha winh a mam ix yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol winh, yujto tojol ix yutej sb'a winh, wach'nhej tas ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' wach'nhej ix ajelk'och winh.
Ix skol heb' meb'a' winh yet' heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chuk spensar. Yuj chi' wach'nhej ix elk'och winh. Ha in Jehová in swala' to a sb'eyb'al winh chi' sch'oxani to yojtak in winh.
Palta a ach tik, anhej b'eyumal tza nib'ej t'a spatik chukal. Tza chekan miljokcham heb' anima malaj smul, tzixtan heb' etchonhab', xchi Jehová.

Syal Jehová yuj winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías sreyal Judá icha tik: Malaj heb' ol ok' yuj schamel winh. Malaj heb' ol halan icha tik: Ay, ach wetanimail. Ob'iltak onh. Toxo ix cham winh ko reyal, icha ko mam yaj winh, manh xchiok heb'.
Icha tz'aj junok nok' chamnak b'uru, icha chi' ol utaj winh, ol nherchajkanel winh t'a tiel chonhab' Jerusalén, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, k'eanhek t'a jolom witz Líbano tzex awaj ta'. Te chaanh tzex awaj t'a jolomtak witz yik Basán yet' t'a tzalkixtak yik Abarim, yujto masanil heb' ayoch heyet'ok toxo ix satel heb'.
Ha in tik, ix wal t'ayex yik wach' eyajek' t'a he chonhab', palta maj yal he k'ol ix eyab'i. Ichanhej chi' ix eyutej he b'a yiktax wanto eyoch chonhab'il, toxon max he cha eyab' tas swala'.

Ol ik'jokb'at heb' eyajalil yuj heb' ajk'ool, icha yik'jib'at junok tas yuj owal ik', haxo heb' ayoch heyet'ok ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il. Toxonhej ol ex q'uixwokkanok. Manhxa ol ajkan eyelk'och yuj jantak he chukal.

Ha tiknaik, te tzalajk'olal eyajek' t'a he pat nab'a k'ute' kotnak ste'al t'a Líbano. Palta ayik ol jawok yaelal t'a eyib'anh, ol el eyaw eyab'an syail, icha yab'an syail junok ix ix tz'alji yune', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Jeconías yuninal winhaj Joacim sreyal Judá: Wach'chom aylaj tzach och wuj icha junok kolk'ab' ayoch t'a swach' k'ab' heb' niwak winak, palta swak' in ti' to ol ach in julkaneli.
Ol ach wak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol b'aj tzach te xiwi, heb' snib'an ach smilanchamok, haton winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.
Ol ach wak' ik'jokb'at yet' ix a nun t'a lum lum b'aj manhok ta' ex alji, hata' ol ex cham he chawanhil.
Manhxo ol ex meltzaj t'a tik, wach'chom olto he nib'ej meltzajxi he b'a, xchi Jehová.
¿Tom lajan winhaj Jeconías tik yet' junok lum chen pojeltak manhxa yopisio, ma icha junok yamk'ab' manhxa mach snib'ani? ¿Tas yuj sjuljikanb'at winh yet' heb' yinhtilal t'a jun lum lum manh yojtakok?
Ab'ek wal ex aj Judá, scham wal eyab'an tas syal Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Tz'ib'chajokab'kan b'aj ay sb'i heb' yinhtilal heb' rey to a jun winak tik, lajan tz'ajkan icha junok winak malaj yuninal, icha junok winak manh wach'ok ix aj yelk'ochi. Yujto manhxa junok yinhtilal winh ol och reyal t'a spalaciokan winhaj David, syak'anxi reyal t'a Judá tik, xchi Jehová.
